tag.name: GA4 - Google tag
tag.notes: Loads GA4 and sends page views. Enhanced measurement (scrolls, outbound clicks, site search) is controlled in the GA4 data stream. visitor_role (visitor, parent or manager) and signed_in (yes or no) go with every page view and event: register both in GA4 as event-scoped custom dimensions.

tag.name: Clarity - Site events
tag.notes: Sends each pas_ event to Clarity as a custom event, so recordings and heatmaps can be filtered by it.

parameter.value:
<script>
(function(){
  var name = {{Event}};
  if (typeof window.clarity === "function" && name) { window.clarity("event", name); }
})();
</script>

variable.name: Page URL - no fragment
variable.notes: The page address without anything after #. Shared roster links carry a child’s first name there.
